description: Application structure combining side navigation, top bar and content area.

howToUse: Use it as the frame of an app: sidebar on the left, top bar and the content of the page.
Configure the sidebar in `sidebar` and the top bar in `topbar`; the page goes in `children`.
Turn on `responsiveSidebar` so the sidebar becomes a drawer on mobile. Limit the reading width with `contentMaxWidth`.
alternatives: A public site page: Hero, Section and SiteFooter.

keyboard.action: Goes through the sidebar, then the top bar, then the page.
Each part keeps its own: see Sidebar, Topbar and WorkspaceSwitcher.

props.name: contentMaxWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the content column. Default 1240px.

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme. When omitted, inherits the global Storybook/app theme.

examples.label: Complete
examples.description: Full layout of the signed-in app, built purely from the real components: Sidebar (WorkspaceSwitcher + UserMenu), Topbar (Breadcrumb + Command trigger), NotificationBell, HelpMenu and a working ⌘K palette.
